Witness Statement - Witness C (Attorney Only)
Date: 01/17/2024

CONFIDENTIAL - ATTORNEY EYE ONLY

I, the undersigned witness, duly swear that the following is my
true and accurate statement regarding the case at hand.

On January 12, 2024, prior to the incident, I had been directed
by the defendant to secure the victim's vehicle. I drove the
vehicle to a parking lot outside the city limits at 7:00 PM. I
directly observed the condition of the vehicle before it was
transported.

This information is privileged and must be kept within counsel
only.

Sincerely,
Witness C

Witness Statement - Witness B
Date: 01/16/2024

I, the undersigned witness, duly swear that the following is my
true and accurate statement regarding the case at hand.

On January 11, 2024, I was working the night shift at the local
building adjacent to the crime scene. At approximately 8:45 PM, I
heard commotion coming from the victim's residence. I called
police and remained on the scene until officers arrived at 9:05 PM.

No one left the area until after law enforcement arrived.

Sincerely,
Witness B
